question: What is a Datalayer wallet credit worth when bought as a top-up? The pricing page prints no per-credit purchase price, and the top-up price list (the iam stripe plans/prices route the pricing page calls) answers HTTP 401 to an anonymous read, so a pack price and its expiry need an authenticated session.
why: the Free plan's 50 credits are priced only through the sandbox rate (USD 0.3 per hour for 3 credits), which is the consumption rate and not the purchase rate
